journalist.en: When journalists visit and ask him about his role, he is charming and unhelpful.

journalist.en: Then, in the last years of his life, Earp found a journalist named Stuart Lake.
journalist.zh: 后来，在人生的最后几年，Earp 找到了一位名叫 Stuart Lake 的记者。

journalist.en: Let's return to Afia Pokua, the journalist who criticised the King of the Ashanti tribe.
journalist.zh: 让我们回到阿菲娅·波库阿，那个批评阿香提部落国王的记者。

journalist.en: Protests were crushed, journalists locked up, and that “state of emergency” Mubarak loved so much?

journalist.en: And I spoke to BBC journalist Alvaro Alvarez, who told me more about the idea.

journey.en: Native podcasts, books, or news articles might be the next step in your journey.
journey.zh: 原版播客、书籍或新闻文章可能是你旅程中的下一步。

journey.en: Fawcett himself was unwavering, but he decided not to make the journey alone.
journey.zh: Fawcett 本人坚定不移，但他决定不独自踏上这段旅程。

journey.en: But this episode, I want to be a bit more focused on my language learning journey.
journey.zh: 但在这期节目中，我想更专注地聊聊我的语言学习历程。

journey.en: The journey from Italian puppet to British icon would take the best part of two centuries.
journey.zh: 从一个意大利木偶演变成英国的文化标志，花了将近两个世纪的时间。

journal.en: It could be talking to yourself or writing a journal or having a conversation.
journal.zh: 这可以是自言自语、写日记或进行对话。

journal.en: Write a one page journal entry every week reflecting on something you learned or did in the previous week.
journal.zh: 每周写一篇一页纸的日记，反思你在过去一周学到了什么或做了什么。

joint.en: His father died when he was only 8 years old, and his uncle and grandfather stepped up as sort of joint father figures.

joint.en: A roast joint of beef would usually just be seasoned with salt and pepper, some herbs as well, and then served with vegetables and gravy and perhaps horseradish or mustard.
joint.zh: 一大块烤牛肉通常只用盐、胡椒和一些草药调味，然后搭配蔬菜、肉汁，或许还有辣根或芥末一起食用。

joyful.en: But behind the beautiful scenery and joyful name lies a far more complicated, and often dark, history.
joyful.zh: 但在美丽的风景和欢乐的名字背后，隐藏着一段更加复杂、而且往往黑暗的历史。
